limitations: Productive wall time is the union of completed retained green segments on runs with accepted nonempty changes; it is a verifier-based proxy, not business-value evidence.
Horizon median bounds include decision-free runs as right-censored intervals. A point median is reported only when the bounds coincide; the observed-decision median is separate.
Metrics never grant unattended execution. Recorded provider, observation, and oracle admission determine each run's grant.
Local same-user predicate passes do not establish inaccessible-oracle verification or either product launch gate.
Unsupported historical records are excluded; missing metrics are not zero measurements.
